notes: Blindspot is a positive finding only. Absent → API { present: false, rule_id: null }; UI omits the row. Requires outlet_count >= 2.

rules.definition: No left or lean_left outlets in the cluster while lean_right/right coverage is present and the story has clear partisan stakes.
No right or lean_right outlets in the cluster while left/lean_left coverage is present and the story has clear partisan stakes.
Only partisan outlets (left/right bands); no center member when wire/center sources typically cover this beat.
One spectrum side has ≤1 member while the other has ≥3, on a high-stakes contested story.
Cluster is all commentary/secondary; no primary doc, paper, filing, or official release when one exists and is material (pairs with source_code framing).
Story has material non-US impact but members are US-only outlets (country field).
